name: Rizuhble's Lane Bully Bebop
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-4,800 (levels 1-10). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Sticky Bomb T1.

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Snatch, 16800 souls (~16.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Stalker
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Snatch, 12800 souls (~12.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)
items.legacy_note: Hook, uppercut: the Spirit Strike hit drops their bullet resist for your gun.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 4,800-20,800 (levels 10-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Exploding Uppercut T3, Grapple Arm T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Sticky Bomb, damage) grows from 122 to 277. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Headhunter, vitality 4.8k at Veil Walker, spirit 4.8k at Spirit Snatch. Ultimate (Hyper Beam) is available from Headhunter.

items.name: Headhunter
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Headshot Booster (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Veil Walker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Walk through a veil, then walk up to them unseen for the hook.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: With this you hunt solo side-lane gun carries.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Spirit Strike (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Extra Health
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Fortitude completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Fortitude completes 6.4k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Fortitude
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,800-46,400 (levels 26-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Hyper Beam T3.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
sections.desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown before it lands, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Bullet Resilience isn't enough.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: If you keep getting stunned or silenced before you can hook.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their team has 2+ heroes who dash away after your hook: Dynamo, Shiv, Lash, Mirage.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 27,200 to 30,400 invested: bonus 60 to 66 vitality bonus.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 27,200 to 30,400 invested: bonus 60 to 66 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
